title: Our Ingredients
slide_intent: Help the reader find a topic and recognize when guidance is provisional.
strategic_value: An inventory can connect individual disciplines to one system while keeping the status of a developing typeface visible.
demonstration: Two columns pair topics with folios. Typography carries an asterisk that leads to a red footnote.
practical_value: Use the printed contents as a section map and the asterisk to identify a qualification on the type guidance.

content_islands.name: Contents label
content_islands.spec: Set the small running labels and Our Ingredients at upper left.

content_islands.name: Section index
content_islands.spec: Group the ten topics in two columns. Set page numbers like superscripts beside the topic names.

content_islands.name: Typeface qualification
content_islands.spec: Keep the asterisk and note together through the same red accent at the foot of the page.
